def _t2_index(root: Path) -> list[dict]:
    import stat

    items = []
    try:
        initial = root.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return items
    if stat.S_ISLNK(initial.st_mode):
        return [{"path": str(root), "mode": initial.st_mode, "bytes": initial.st_size,
                 "inode": initial.st_ino, "symlink": True,
                 "link_target": os.readlink(root)}]
    pending = [root]
    while pending:
        directory = pending.pop()
        with os.scandir(directory) as entries:
            for entry in sorted(entries, key=lambda value: value.name):
                path = Path(entry.path)
                info = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
                value = {"path": str(path), "mode": info.st_mode, "bytes": info.st_size,
                         "inode": info.st_ino, "symlink": stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)}
                if value["symlink"]:
                    value["link_target"] = os.readlink(path)
                elif stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                    pending.append(path)
                elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
                    value["sha256"] = sha(path)
                items.append(value)
                if len(items) > 10000:
                    raise ValueError("T2 finite file index cap exceeded")
    return items




def author_bytes(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode()


def cas_author(path, expected_raw, value, mode, progress):
    require(stable_bytes(path) == expected_raw
            and stat.S_IMODE(path.lstat().st_mode) == mode,
            "author immediate full-bytes/mode CAS failed")
    raw = author_bytes(value)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".r296-next")
    write_bytes(temporary, raw, mode)
    require(stat.S_IMODE(temporary.lstat().st_mode) == mode,
            "replacement must retain original author mode")
    require(stable_bytes(path) == expected_raw
            and stat.S_IMODE(path.lstat().st_mode) == mode,
            "author changed before atomic replacement")
    progress["replace_attempted"] = True
    os.replace(temporary, path)
    progress["replaced"] = True
    require(stable_bytes(path) == raw and stat.S_IMODE(path.lstat().st_mode) == mode,
            "author exact mutation/mode readback differs")
    progress["readback_verified"] = True
    return raw


def strict_index(root):
    rows = _t2_index(root)
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), "persistent basetemp must remain a real directory")
    by_path = {row["path"]: row for row in rows}
    require(len(by_path) == len(rows), "duplicate persistent index path")
    for row in rows:
        path = Path(row["path"])
        info = path.lstat()
        require(info.st_mode == row["mode"] and info.st_size == row["bytes"]
                and info.st_ino == row["inode"], "persistent index lstat changed")
        if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
            raw = stable_bytes(path)
            require(not row["symlink"] and bytes_pin(path, raw) == {
                "path": row["path"], "bytes": row["bytes"], "sha256": row["sha256"]},
                    "regular-file own SHA differs")
        elif stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
            require(not row["symlink"] and "sha256" not in row, "directory is not a file pin")
        elif stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
            target_text = os.readlink(path)
            require(row["symlink"] and row["link_target"] == target_text and "sha256" not in row,
                    "symlink must retain its own link text only")
            target = Path(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(str(path.parent), target_text)))
            require(target.is_relative_to(root) and str(target) in by_path
                    and not by_path[str(target)]["symlink"], "symlink target escapes, missing or chains")
        else:
            raise ValueError("unexpected special persistent file")
    return rows


def retained_new_databases(index, evidence):
    records = []
    for row in index:
        path = Path(row["path"])
        if not stat.S_ISREG(row["mode"]) or path.suffix not in {".db", ".sqlite", ".sqlite3"}:
            continue
        raw = stable_bytes(path)
        require(bytes_pin(path, raw) == pin_identity(row), "new regular DB index changed")
        archive = write_bytes(evidence / "retained-databases" / (str(len(records)) + path.suffix), raw)
        sides = []
        for suffix in ("-wal", "-shm", "-journal"):
            side = Path(str(path) + suffix)
            if side.exists() or side.is_symlink():
                side_raw = stable_bytes(side)
                side_pin = bytes_pin(side, side_raw)
                side_archive = write_bytes(evidence / "retained-databases" / (
                    str(len(records)) + path.suffix + suffix), side_raw)
                sides.append({"path": str(side), "exists": True, "is_symlink": False,
                              "pin": side_pin, "archive": side_archive})
            else:
                sides.append({"path": str(side), "exists": False, "is_symlink": False, "pin": None})
        records.append({"pin": bytes_pin(path, raw), "archive": archive, "sidecars": sides,
                        "provenance": "This genuine new R296 diagnostic run only; old bytes not recovered"})
    return records

    require(set(full_before) == set(roles.values()), "exact new role-before paths required")
    root_before, author_before = (decode_json(full_before[roles[key]]) for key in ("ROOT", "AUTHOR"))
    for role, value in (("ROOT", root_before), ("AUTHOR", author_before)):
        require(value["round"] == "R296" and value["role"] == role
                and pin_identity(value["plan"]) == pin_identity(gate["plan"])
                and set(value["commands"]) == {name}, "new role identity differs")
        entry = value["commands"][name]
        require(entry["authorized"] == 1 and entry["used"] == 0 and entry["remaining"] == 1
                and entry["state"] == "HELD_PENDING_ROOT_SOURCE_INPUT_ARGV_GATE"
                and entry["command"] == command, "selected role must be HELD0/1")
    continuation = {"reservation_id": reservation["reservation_id"], "plan": reservation["plan"],
                    "source_gate": reservation["source_gate"], "script_gate": reservation["script_gate"],
                    "sources": sources, "command": command}
    root_expected = copy.deepcopy(root_before)
    selected = root_expected["commands"][name]
    selected.update(state="RESERVED_BY_ROOT", used=1, remaining=0, reservation_id=reservation["reservation_id"])
    selected.setdefault("continuation", {})["R296"] = continuation
    require(reservation["root_role_after"]["path"] == roles["ROOT"]
            and decode_json(checked(reservation["root_role_after"])) == root_expected,
            "ROOT selected-key exact CAS transition differs")
    author_raw = checked(reservation["author_role_before"])
    require(reservation["author_role_before"]["path"] == roles["AUTHOR"]
            and author_raw == full_before[roles["AUTHOR"]], "author exact current before differs")
    stable = [_t2_pin(source_path), _t2_pin(script_path), _t2_pin(reservation_path),
              reservation["root_role_after"], gate["context_manifest"], gate["supplement"]]
    context = {"plan": plan, "observation": observation, "supplement": supplement, "command": command,
               "name": name, "source_gate": gate, "sources": sources, "reservation": reservation,
               "context_manifest": context_manifest, "stable_controls": stable,
               "author_before": author_before, "author_raw": author_raw,
               "author_path": Path(roles["AUTHOR"]), "continuation": continuation}
    context["paths"] = command_paths(command)
    require(context["paths"]["directory"] == D / "implementation" / name, "exact output directory required")
    absence(context["paths"]["directory"])
    context["before_check"] = authority(context)
    return context

def junit_observation(path, node):
    if not path.exists():
        return {"pin": None, "available": False, "reason": "No JUnit file actually produced",
                "tests": None, "failures": None, "errors": None, "skips": None}
    raw = stable_bytes(path)
    tree = ET.fromstring(raw)
    rows = []
    for element in tree.iter("testcase"):
        rows.append({"nodeid": element.attrib["classname"].replace(".", "/") + ".py::" + element.attrib["name"],
                     "attributes": dict(element.attrib),
                     "outcomes": [{"tag": v.tag, "attributes": dict(v.attrib), "text": v.text}
                                  for v in element if v.tag in {"failure", "error", "skipped"}]})
    require([row["nodeid"] for row in rows] == [node], "JUnit selected-node identity differs")
    return {"pin": bytes_pin(path, raw), "available": True, "records": rows, "tests": len(rows),
            "failures": sum(any(v["tag"] == "failure" for v in r["outcomes"]) for r in rows),
            "errors": sum(any(v["tag"] == "error" for v in r["outcomes"]) for r in rows),
            "skips": sum(any(v["tag"] == "skipped" for v in r["outcomes"]) for r in rows)}

def rpc_witnesses(events, sessions, resource_map, threads):
    seen, unavailable, facts = set(), [], []
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(events):
        if row["category"] == "post_unwind_original_exception":
            require("rpc_timeout_witness" not in row, "post-unwind cannot invent timeout witness")
            continue
        sid = row["snapshot"]["session_id"]
        trigger = row["category"] == "invalidate:call" and row["original_reason"] == "RPC wait cap exceeded"
        expected = trigger and sid not in seen
        witness = row.get("rpc_timeout_witness")
        require((witness is not None) == expected, "exact first-only RPC timeout witness required")
        if not expected:
            continue
        seen.add(sid)
        require(type(witness) is dict and witness["session_id"] == sid
                and witness["event_ordinal"] == ordinal and witness["non_atomic"] is True
                and witness["selection"] == "FIRST_OBSERVED_RPC_WAIT_CAP_EXCEEDED_PER_SESSION"
                and witness["current_frames_calls"] == 1
                and type(witness["unavailable"]) is list, "RPC witness identity/one-sample bound differs")
        require(type(witness["caller"]) is dict, "explicit original RPC caller observation required")
        caller = witness["caller"]
        valid_caller = caller["exact_original_rpc"] is True
        if valid_caller:
            require(caller["filename"] == str(ROOT / "src/cloud_edge_robot_arm/simulation_runtime/operational_lease.py")
                    and caller["firstlineno"] == 530 and type(caller["lineno"]) is int,
                    "original immediate RPC caller differs")
        else:
            unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "original RPC caller unavailable"})
        request = witness["request"]
        if request is None:
            unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "original Request unavailable"})
        else:
            require(valid_caller and type(request) is dict and request["exact_class"] is True
                    and type(request["request_id"]) is int and request["request_id"] > 0,
                    "original Request identity required")
            for key in ("kind", "role"):
                value = request[key]
                require(value is None or type(value) is str or type(value) is dict,
                        "request bounded native-string observation required")
                if type(value) is str:
                    require(len(value.encode("utf-8")) <= 1024, "request native string cap exceeded")
                if value is None:
                    unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "request " + key + " unavailable"})
            for key in ("view_id", "ack_id"):
                require(request[key] is None or type(request[key]) is int and request[key] > 0,
                        "view/ack identity only required")
            for key in ("completed", "cancelled"):
                flag = request[key]
                require(type(flag) is dict and (flag["event_id"] is None or type(flag["event_id"]) is int)
                        and (flag["flag"] is None or type(flag["flag"]) is bool),
                        "exact Event primitive dictionary observation required")
                if flag["flag"] is None or flag["unavailable"] is not None:
                    unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "request " + key + " unavailable"})
            error = request["error_type"]
            require(error is None or type(error) is dict and set(error) == {"module", "name"},
                    "request error is type-only, never str/repr")
        locations = witness["threads"]
        require(type(locations) is dict and set(locations) == {"main", "broker"},
                "only exact existing main/broker frames permitted")
        for label in ("main", "broker"):
            value = locations[label]
            require(type(value) is dict and type(value["available"]) is bool,
                    "explicit sampled thread availability required")
            if not value["available"]:
                require(value["stack"] is None and value["unavailable"] is not None,
                        "unavailable thread cannot fabricate empty stack")
                unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": label + " stack unavailable"})
                continue
            require(type(value["thread_id"]) is int and type(value["native_thread_id"]) is int,
                    "sampled thread coordinates required")
            stack = value["stack"]
            require(type(stack) is dict and type(stack["locations"]) is list
                    and 1 <= len(stack["locations"]) <= 12
                    and type(stack["omitted_more_frames"]) is bool, "sampled native frame bound differs")
            for loc in stack["locations"]:
                require(type(loc["firstlineno"]) is int and type(loc["current_lineno"]) is int
                        and type(loc["filename"]) in (str, dict) and type(loc["name"]) in (str, dict),
                        "detached native frame location fields required")
            if label == "main":
                require(value["thread_id"] == row["snapshot"]["main_thread"]
                        and value["native_thread_id"] == row["snapshot"]["main_native_thread"],
                        "original session main thread identity differs")
            else:
                object_id = value["thread_object_id"]
                if object_id not in resource_map:
                    unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "broker actual resource witness unavailable"})
                else:
                    resource, side_pin = resource_map[object_id]
                    require(resource["kind"] == "broker_thread" and resource["session_resource_id"] == sid
                            and resource["thread_ident"] == value["thread_id"]
                            and resource["native_thread_id"] == value["native_thread_id"],
                            "exact existing broker resource/session/thread differs")
            if (value["thread_id"], value["native_thread_id"]) not in threads:
                unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": label + " completed thread witness unavailable"})
        for reason in witness["unavailable"]:
            require(type(reason) is str, "bounded primitive unavailable reason required")
            unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": reason})
        facts.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "session_id": sid, "witness": witness})
    for session in sessions:
        require(bool(session.get("rpc_timeout_witness_attempted", False)) == (session["session_id"] in seen),
                "first RPC witness selection state differs from actual events")
    return {"records": facts, "unavailable": unavailable, "first_cause": "UNKNOWN"}

    for path in files:
        raw = stable_bytes(path)

        require(total <= 131072, "R296 total passive128KiB exceeded")
        value = decode_json(raw)

                and value["nodeid"] == node and value["pid"] == pid,

        records.append({"pin": bytes_pin(path, raw), "data": value})
        contents[path.name] = value
        errors.extend(value["observer_errors"])
    event_file, summary = contents.get("events.json"), contents.get("summary.json")
    if event_file is None or summary is None:
        if not timed_out:
            errors.append({"type": "MissingPassivePersistence", "message": "Normal child produced no complete two-file capture"})
        return {"records": records, "summary": summary, "total_utf8_bytes": total,
                "complete": False, "incomplete": True, "observer_errors": errors,
                "unavailable": "One or both real passive files absent", "first_cause": None,

    events, sessions = event_file["records"], event_file["first_observed"]
    require(type(events) is list and len(events) == event_file["events_count"] <= 6 * 64 + 3
            and type(sessions) is list and len(sessions) <= 6, "passive session/event cap differs")
    session_map = {q["session_id"]: q for q in sessions}
    require(len(session_map) == len(sessions), "duplicate passive session identity")
    resource_map, threads = {}, set()
    for side in (resources or {}).get("records", []):
        data = side["data"]
        if type(data) is not dict:
            continue
        require(data["pid"] == pid and data["nodeid"] == node, "actual resource sidecar identity differs")
        for q in data["resources"]:
            resource_map[q["resource_id"]] = (q, side["pin"])
            if q["kind"] in {"broker_thread", "heartbeat_thread"}:
                if type(q.get("thread_ident")) is int and type(q.get("native_thread_id")) is int:
                    threads.add((q["thread_ident"], q["native_thread_id"]))
        for q in data["worker_lifecycles"]:
            if q["entered"]:
                threads.add((q["thread_id"], q["native_thread_id"]))
    counts, first, witnesses, unavailable = {}, {}, [], []
    target_events = {
        ("__init__", 417): {"call", "line455", "return"},
        ("invalidate", 640): {"call"},
        ("_check_ingress", 468): {"line471", "exception"},
        ("_close_worker_lease_session", 982): {"call", "line987", "return"},
    }
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(events):
        require(row["ordinal"] == ordinal, "passive event ordinal differs")
        if row["category"] == "post_unwind_original_exception":
            require(len(row["actual_target_tracebacks"]) <= 12, "post-unwind traceback cap differs")
            for loc in row["actual_target_tracebacks"]:
                require((loc["code_name"], loc["code_firstlineno"]) in target_events
                        and loc["code_filename"] == str(ROOT / "src/cloud_edge_robot_arm/simulation_runtime/operational_lease.py")
                        and type(loc["tb_lineno"]) is int and type(loc["post_unwind_frame_lineno"]) is int,
                        "real selected traceback location differs")
            continue
        code = (row["code_name"], row["code_firstlineno"])
        selected = "line" + str(row["trace_lineno"]) if row["trace_event"] == "line" else row["trace_event"]
        require(code in target_events and selected in target_events[code]
                and row["category"] == row["code_name"] + ":" + selected
                and row["pid"] == pid
                and row["code_filename"] == str(ROOT / "src/cloud_edge_robot_arm/simulation_runtime/operational_lease.py")
                and len(row["stack"]["locations"]) <= 12,
                "actual traced function/event/identity differs")
        snapshot = row["snapshot"]
        sid = snapshot["session_id"]
        require(type(sid) is int and sid in session_map, "event lacks its actual session identity")
        counts[sid] = counts.get(sid, 0) + 1
        require(counts[sid] <= 64, "per-session64 event cap exceeded")
        first.setdefault(sid, {}).setdefault(row["category"], ordinal)
        if sid in resource_map:
            resource, side_pin = resource_map[sid]
            require(resource["kind"] == "lease_session", "traced session ID resolves to wrong actual resource")
            worker = snapshot.get("worker_object_id")
            observed_worker = resource.get("worker_resource_id")
            if worker is not None and observed_worker is not None:
                require(worker == observed_worker, "traced and sidecar actual worker IDs differ")
                witnesses.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "session_resource_id": sid,
                                  "worker_resource_id": observed_worker, "sidecar": side_pin})
            else:
                unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "partial session worker ownership unavailable"})
        else:
            unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "no completed actual session sidecar witness"})
        if (row["thread_id"], row["native_thread_id"]) not in threads:
            unavailable.append({"event_ordinal": ordinal, "reason": "actual thread pair not witnessed by completed sidecar"})
    for sid, session in session_map.items():

require(session["event_count"] == counts.get(sid, 0)
                and session["first_observed"] == first.get(sid, {}), "first observed event was changed or lost")
        if "first_observed_invalidate" in session:
            original = session["first_observed_invalidate"]
            n = first[sid]["invalidate:call"]
            require(original == {"ordinal": n, "original_reason": events[n]["original_reason"]},
                    "first invalidation reason overwritten by later cleanup")
    require(event_file["accounting"] == summary["accounting"], "compact accounting envelopes differ")
    accounting = event_file["accounting"]
    charges, measured = accounting["record_charges"], accounting["measured_record_bytes"]
    require(accounting["method"] == "COMPACT_PRIMITIVE_TREE_UTF8_ESCAPE_BOUND"
            and accounting["record_payload_budget"] == 98304 and accounting["metadata_reserved_bytes"] == 32768
            and type(charges) is list and type(measured) is list
            and len(charges) == len(measured) == len(events)
            and all(type(x) is int and x >= 0 for x in charges + measured)
            and sum(charges) == accounting["charged_record_bytes"] <= 98304,
            "compact record charges/bounds differ")
    for row, charged, actual in zip(events, charges, measured):
        require(len(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False,
                               separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")) == actual <= charged,
                "actual compact primitive record size differs")
    accounting_complete = (accounting["verified"] is True and accounting["failure"] is None
                           and type(accounting["attempted_records"]) is int
                           and accounting["attempted_records"] == len(events) + event_file["dropped_events"])
    if not accounting_complete:
        errors.append({"type": "CompactAdmissionIncomplete", "message": "Actual attempts/charges/drop accounting incomplete"})
    rpc = rpc_witnesses(events, sessions, resource_map, threads)
    unavailable.extend(rpc["unavailable"])
    restored = (summary["call_finally_observed"] is True and summary["hooks_equal"] is True
                and summary["hooks_before"] == summary["hooks_after"]
                and summary["new_threads_still_live"] == [])
    if not restored:
        errors.append({"type": "TraceRestorationIncomplete", "message": "Real trace/profile/thread restoration unavailable"})
    complete = bool(restored and not errors and not unavailable and not event_file["cap_hit"]
                    and event_file["dropped_events"] == 0 and event_file["incomplete"] is False
                    and summary["normal_sessionfinish_observed"] is True and sessions)
    return {"records": records, "summary": summary, "total_utf8_bytes": total,
            "complete": complete, "incomplete": not complete, "observer_errors": errors,
            "cap_hit": event_file["cap_hit"], "dropped_events": event_file["dropped_events"],
            "session_resource_witnesses": witnesses, "unavailable_witnesses": unavailable,
            "rpc_timeout_evidence": rpc, "compact_accounting": accounting,
            "first_cause": "UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_ROOT_EVENT_INTERPRETATION",
            "normal_finish_observed": True, "legal_RED": False, "GREEN": False}


def completion_marker_fact(container):
    if type(container) is not dict:
        return {"present": None, "type": None, "value": None,
                "interpretation": "container unavailable or malformed"}
    if "assertions_completed" not in container:
        return {"present": False, "type": None, "value": None,
                "interpretation": "unobserved at this location"}
    value = container["assertions_completed"]
    return {"present": True, "type": type(value).__name__, "value": value,
            "interpretation": "observed at this location"}


def behavior_resources_complete(summary, *, facts):
    facts.update({"eligible": False, "reason": None, "records": []})
    if type(summary) is not dict or type(summary.get("records")) is not list:
        facts["reason"] = "resource summary or records unavailable/malformed"
        return False
    eligible = bool(summary["records"] and summary.get("all_records_valid") is True
                    and summary.get("complete_sidecar_set") is True)
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(summary["records"]):
        data = row.get("data") if type(row) is dict else None
        observations = data.get("observations") if type(data) is dict else None
        top = completion_marker_fact(data)
        nested = completion_marker_fact(observations)
        valid = bool(type(data) is dict and type(observations) is dict
                     and data.get("entered_behavior") is True
                     and nested["present"] is True and nested["type"] == "bool"
                     and nested["value"] is True)
        reason = None
        if type(data) is not dict:
            reason = "data unavailable/malformed"
        elif type(observations) is not dict:
            reason = "observations unavailable/malformed"
        elif nested["present"] is not True:
            reason = "nested completion marker absent"
        elif nested["type"] != "bool":
            reason = "nested completion marker has non-bool type"
        elif nested["value"] is not True:
            reason = "nested completion marker observed false"
        elif data.get("entered_behavior") is not True:
            reason = "entered_behavior is not true"
        facts["records"].append({
            "ordinal": ordinal, "data_type": type(data).__name__,
            "observations_present": type(data) is dict and "observations" in data,
            "observations_type": type(observations).__name__,
            "top_level": top, "nested": nested, "eligible": valid, "reason": reason})
        eligible = eligible and valid
    facts["eligible"] = bool(eligible)
    facts["reason"] = None if eligible else "resource prerequisites or nested completion not satisfied"
    return facts["eligible"]

def record_event(frame, event, arg):
    found = target(frame)
    if found is None:
        return
    spec, session = found
    category = "line" + str(frame.f_lineno) if event == "line" else event
    if category not in spec[1]:
        return
    sid = id(session)
    sessions = _STATE["sessions"]
    if sid not in sessions:
        if len(sessions) >= 6:
            _STATE["attempted_records"] += 1
            drop("sessions6")
            return
        sessions[sid] = {"session_id": sid, "event_count": 0, "epoch": None, "first_observed": {}}
    session_row = sessions[sid]
    snapshot = session_snapshot(frame, session)
    epoch = snapshot.get("epoch")
    if type(epoch) is str:
        if session_row["epoch"] is not None and session_row["epoch"] != epoch:
            drop("session_identity_reused")
            return
        session_row["epoch"] = epoch
    tid, native = threading.get_ident(), threading.get_native_id()
    _STATE["observed_threads"].add(tid)
    row = {"category": frame.f_code.co_name + ":" + category, "trace_event": event,
           "trace_lineno": frame.f_lineno, "code_filename": frame.f_code.co_filename,
           "code_name": frame.f_code.co_name, "code_firstlineno": frame.f_code.co_firstlineno,
           "pid": os.getpid(), "thread_id": tid, "native_thread_id": native,
           "snapshot": snapshot, "stack": stack_locations(frame),
           "original_reason": primitive(frame.f_locals.get("reason")),
           "profile_ids_during_event": [None if x is None else id(x)
                                       for x in (sys.getprofile(), threading.getprofile())]}
    if event == "exception":
        row["exception"] = exception_fields(arg[1])
        tb = arg[2]
        row["actual_tb_lineno_at_trace_event"] = tb.tb_lineno if tb is not None else None
        tb = None
    if (row["category"] == "invalidate:call" and row["original_reason"] == "RPC wait cap exceeded"
            and not session_row.get("rpc_timeout_witness_attempted", False)):
        session_row["rpc_timeout_witness_attempted"] = True
        row["rpc_timeout_witness"] = rpc_timeout_witness(frame, session, len(_STATE["records"]))
    append_record(row, session_row)
    session = None
    found = None

def global_dispatch(frame, event, arg):

@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True, tryfirst=True)
def pytest_runtest_call(item):
    if _STATE is None or item.nodeid != NODE:
        raise RuntimeError("one exact R296 dual call required")
    before = hook_values()
    if before[0] is not None or before[1] is not None:
        error_record("unknown preexisting trace", RuntimeError())
        raise RuntimeError("R296 refuses unknown preexisting trace")
    _STATE["hooks_before"] = hook_records(before)
    _STATE["call_started"] = True
    baseline = set(live_thread_ids())
    installed = False
    try:
        threading.settrace(global_dispatch)
        installed = True
        sys.settrace(global_dispatch)
        yield
    finally:
        observed_hooks = hook_values()
        _STATE["hooks_before_restoration"] = hook_records(observed_hooks)
        if installed and (observed_hooks[0] is not global_dispatch
                          or observed_hooks[1] is not global_dispatch):
            _STATE["incomplete"] = True
        for setter, value, label in ((sys.settrace, before[0], "sys"),
                                     (threading.settrace, before[1], "threading")):
            try:
                setter(value)
            except BaseException as error:
                error_record(label + " trace restoration", error)
        after = hook_values()
        _STATE["hooks_after"] = hook_records(after)
        _STATE["hooks_equal"] = all(a is b for a, b in zip(before, after))
        _STATE["call_finally_observed"] = True
        _STATE["trace_install_attempted"] = installed
        remaining = sorted((_STATE["observed_threads"] - baseline) & set(live_thread_ids()))
        _STATE["new_threads_still_live"] = remaining
        _STATE["per_thread_trace_restoration"] = (
            "ORIGINAL_THREADS_TERMINATED" if not remaining else "UNAVAILABLE_FOR_STILL_LIVE_THREADS")
        if remaining or not _STATE["hooks_equal"]:
            _STATE["incomplete"] = True
